dedupe_keys.name: virginia deq data centre air permits backup generator permits with the public evidence project index

description: Data centres in Virginia need air permits from the Virginia Department of Environmental Quality for the diesel backup generators that keep them running during grid outages, so the permits reveal where facilities are and how much emergency generation they hold. The Public Evidence Project published on Harvard Dataverse in July 2026 a source-linked, versioned index of 198 DEQ-issued data centre air permit rows from the agency snapshot of 13 July 2026, with facility name, permit identifier, issue date, programme type, locality, regional office and a direct link to the agency document, normalised for reuse. DEQ remains the controlling source for permit status and content. Coverage: Virginia, permits to July 2026. Format and access: CSV and documentation on Harvard Dataverse, free of charge; the permit documents are public on the DEQ website. Caveats: a permit does not show construction, operation, actual emissions or compliance; facility names may not reveal owners; generator capacities must be read from the permit documents. Simulation uses: backup power at data centres for studies of their behaviour during grid outages, air quality exposure when many generators run, and interdependency between power and digital infrastructure. Related records: the Virginia data centre facility dataset and the IM3 data centre load projections.
